state_meaning: AI-drafted candidate; no person has reviewed it.
text: The authors train language models to debate using self-play data and report that, on a long-context reading comprehension task, language-model judges answer more accurately when judging models optimised to win debates, while no such relationship holds for consultancy models trained to persuade a judge without an opposing debater. In comparisons with novel consultancy baselines, they find evidence that debate training encourages stronger and more informative arguments.
title: Self-play debate training improves LLM judge accuracy; consultancy training does not
